sources.entry: Weblate - Web-based translation tool with tight version control integration. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Python/Docker/K8S

summary.one_liner: Weblate is a web-based, open-source localization platform for translating software and content, which can be self-hosted or used as hosted service at weblate.org.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Weblate as a privacy-respecting, open-source localization platform that users can run themselves or use via Hosted Weblate. It points to a docs directory in the source tree (and an online version) for documentation and has an installation section, though the setup steps themselves are not included in the README text. It states that optional professional support and cloud hosting are available. Bugs and feature requests go to the project's issue tracker, and accessibility problems have a separate template and an ACCESSIBILITY.md guide. The README gives no detailed feature list beyond the awesome-selfhosted description of tight version control integration.
how_to_run: See the docs directory in the source code for setup instructions
Or use Hosted Weblate at weblate.org instead of self-hosting
notable: Privacy-respecting, open-source localization platform under the user's control
Can be self-hosted or used as Hosted Weblate cloud service
Documentation is kept in the repository's docs directory
Has a dedicated accessibility reporting process with ACCESSIBILITY.md
caveats: README does not include the installation steps; they are referenced in the docs
Optional professional support and cloud hosting are paid offerings mentioned by the project
